[EVENT] User needs to finalize their product line and pricing for handmade crafts, specifically soap and lotion bars.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on your success at the Spring Fling Market!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To determine the optimal price for handmade crafts, consider the following tips:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Calculate your costs: Include materials, packaging, and other expenses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Time is money: Factor in the time taken to create each item.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Research the market: Look at similar products' prices locally and online.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Quality and uniqueness: Charge a premium for high-quality, unique products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Target profit margin: Aim for a profit margin of 25-50%.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Pricing psychology: Use prices ending in .99 or .95 for affordability perception.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Test and adjust: Be ready to modify prices based on feedback and sales data.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General pricing guidelines for soap and lotion bars:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Soap bars: $5-$12 per bar, depending on size and ingredients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * Lotion bars: $8-$15 per bar, depending on size and ingredients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User may want to position their soap and lotion bars as a premium product, potentially at the higher end of the suggested ranges.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Consider offering different sizes or variations of products to cater to different customer segments and price points.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Remember to factor in costs associated with selling at the Night Market, such as table rental fees, transportation, and marketing expenses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] I hope these tips help you determine the optimal price for your handmade crafts!
